## {{< iconify octicon:briefcase-24 >}} What I Do

[I]{.drop-cap} build tools that make reproducible research easier for data scientists and researchers.
With a Ph.D. in biostatistics and deep expertise in the Quarto and R ecosystems, I bridge the gap between statistical rigour and practical usability.
My work spans multi-omics data analysis (*e.g.*, genetics, proteomics, metabolomics, transcriptomics, *etc.*) mostly in a research setting, R package development, and Quarto ecosystem contributions.
